en: The postcard features three sepia-toned photographic views arranged with decorative floral motifs. The top left image shows a church and parsonage complex surrounded by a stone wall and greenery. The top right image depicts a village street ('Dorfstrasse') with houses and trees lining the road. The bottom image shows a school building ('Schule') with a symmetric facade and a garden in front. All the text is in German, and the postcard identifies the location as 'Grumbach, Bez. Dresden.'
